source_title: Global Hotelier and Founder of The Estate Sam Nazarian to Join INSPIRE 2026 for a Conversation on "Longevity: The Next Frontier of Luxury."
source_excerpt:
The SBE Founder will sit down with International Luxury Hotel Association Co-founder Jonathan Edelheit on the Encore Summit Stage on December 16
ORLANDO, Fla. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The International Luxury Hotel Association (ILHA) today announced that Sam Nazarian, Founder, Chairman and CEO of sbe Entertainment Group and Founder of The Estate, will take the Encore Summit Stage at INSPIRE 2026 for an in-person conversation with Jonathan Edelheit, Co-founder of ILHA. The session, "Longevity: The Next Frontier of Luxury," opens the second day of the conference on December 16 at JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek Resort & Spa.
Nazarian has shaped lifestyle and luxury hospitality for two decades, from launching SLS Hotels in 2006 to building sbe into one of the industry's most recognized hospitality lifestyle companies. His latest venture, The Estate, co-founded with #1 New York Times Bestselling Author, Entrepreneur, Philanthropist and the #1 Life and Business Strategist, Tony Robbins, is defining a new category: luxury longevity hospitality, where immersive resorts, residences and longevity clubs are designed from the ground up to help people live longer, feel stronger and thrive.
The conversation will explore "Longevity: The Next Frontier of Luxury." Talking points include:
Extending the guest relationship beyond the stay through residential real estate and urban longevity clubs
Where owners and investors see opportunity in the longevity economy
"I'm honored to join the ILHA and engage in such a meaningful discussion about the future of luxury hospitality. Jonathan and his team continue to drive innovative dialogue in our industry and I look forward to a robust conversation about why longevity is the new luxury," said Nazarian.
"Sam has spent his career seeing where luxury is going before the rest of the industry gets there," said Jonathan Edelheit, Co-founder of ILHA. "His move into longevity is one of the most important conversations in hospitality right now, and our audience of owners, operators and developers will want to hear how he is building it."
Read Sam Nazarian's full interview with ILHA here .
The Estate will also be represented on the December 15 panel "Medical Wellness as the New Luxury Differentiator," featuring Kenneth Ryan, Chief Longevity Officer of The Estate.
Nazarian joins an INSPIRE 2026 lineup that includes Tina Edmundson, President of Luxury at Marriott International, Carolyne Doyon, President and CEO of Club Med North America and Caribbean, and Barry Bloom, President and Chief Operating Officer of Xenia Hotels & Resorts.
Registration for INSPIRE 2026 is now open. Visit ilha.org/inspire to learn more and secure a place.
About the International Luxury Hotel Association (ILHA)
The International Luxury Hotel Association (ILHA) is the leading trade association uniting the world of luxury hospitality across its three core pillars: real estate, hospitality, and travel. With a global community of more than 1 million professionals and a think tank of over 300 industry leaders, ILHA drives the conversations, partnerships, and innovations shaping the future of luxury experiences. Its ILHA INSPIRE flagship event brings together senior leaders from across the industry for high-level networking, insights, and collaboration, alongside a year-round content platform connecting owners, operators, developers, and brands. For more information, visit https://ilha.org/
